text:
Maya Chen: planning to roll out the sunset GPU pool autoscale policy at 22:00 UTC tonight. owner: maya. goal: switch min/max from 2/20 -> 4/40, enable burst window, add KV-cache affinity. no infra changes besides policy config.

Liam O'Neil: noted. which pool exactly?

Maya Chen: pool=sunset-prod (region: us-west2). canary at 5% traffic for first 10m, then 25% for 20m, then full cutover if smoke is clean.

Sophia Patel: I'll be on-call for the window (22:00-00:00 UTC). ping me if latency > 200ms or error rate spike > 1%.

Jordan Kim: code change is only the policy yaml, PR #4821 is merged and pinned to the deploy job. small followup: added an eviction grace increase to 120s.

Maya Chen: smoke checklist (short):
1) deploy policy (infra job)
2) watch per-route latency + 95p token time
3) confirm autoscaler scales up to min=4 under synthetic load
4) smoke-gen tests: run `./tools/smoke --pool sunset-prod --qps 30 --len 64`
5) validate fallback to orbit-policy if any OOMs

Liam O'Neil: can you paste the exact deploy command?

Maya Chen: deploy job is `./infra/deploy --target=pool/sunset-prod --config=policies/sunset-autoscale.yaml --canary=5% --owner=maya`

Jordan Kim: rollback command (if needed):
```
./infra/deploy --target=pool/sunset-prod --config=policies/sunset-autoscale-prev.yaml --force
```
This reverts to the previous policy file and triggers immediate policy sync.

Sophia Patel: steps for quick rollback verification after revert:
- check pool.min == 2 in console
- run smoke-gen at qps 30, ensure no new 5xx
- confirm no new eviction logs in /var/log/gpu-allocator

Maya Chen: I've added the runbook link and the escalation list to the PR description: https://redwood.atlassian.org/runbooks/gpu-autoscale. also will leave a pinned message in #eng-oncall.

Liam O'Neil: LGTM from my side. small nit: consider lowering the canary-to-25% step time to 15m? otherwise fine.

Maya Chen: good call — changing 25m -> 15m. updating PR now.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled by Maya Chen at 2025-08-14 22:00 UTC (job id: dpl-7821).

Jordan Kim: i'll tail logs and watch allocator metrics. will report at +5m, +15m, +30m.

Sophia Patel: ping me at +0 and +10 if anything looks off. I'll be in the channel.

Maya Chen: thanks all — will kick at 22:00 UTC. leaving final checklist here: 
- Owner: Maya
- Oncall: Sophia
- Canary: 5% (10m) -> 25% (15m) -> full
- Rollback command saved in PR
- Smoke script: `./tools/smoke --pool sunset-prod`
- Monitoring: per-route latency dashboard, allocator OOM alerts, error-rate alert threshold = 1%

Liam O'Neil: thanks, GLHF :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy started (dpl-7821).
